'''Savannah Hernandez''' (born June 17, 1994) is an American journalist and media personality primarily associated with [[Infowars]], a far-right media platform known for promoting conspiracy theories. She has gained notoriety for her coverage of controversial topics and close working relationship with Infowars founder [[Alex Jones]].

== Career ==
Savannah Hernandez began her career in journalism after graduating from the University of Texas. She initially worked for local news stations before becoming involved with alternative media outlets. Her style of confrontational journalism and live-streamed interviews attracted Infowars, where she was eventually hired.

=== Infowars and Controversies ===
While working at Infowars, Hernandez has been involved in several controversies. She has been a vocal proponent of various conspiracy theories, including those related to the COVID-19 pandemic, the 2020 U.S. presidential election, and alleged government cover-ups. Her reports often challenge mainstream narratives, which has led to criticism from fact-checkers and media watchdogs.

Hernandez's alliance with Infowars has drawn significant media attention, particularly due to her association with Alex Jones. She has appeared alongside Jones in multiple Infowars broadcasts, sharing platforms with him during public protests and political rallies. The partnership has bolstered her visibility among far-right circles, while also exposing her to widespread scrutiny.

== Criticism ==
Savannah Hernandez's reporting style and the content of her journalism often attract criticism for spreading misinformation and contributing to public distrust in established media organizations. Detractors argue that her work with Infowars perpetuates harmful conspiracies that undermine public discourse and civic processes.

== Personal Life ==
Little is publicly known about Hernandez's personal life, as she tends to keep it private. She continues to reside in Austin, Texas, remaining active in both journalism and alternative media circles.
